10985677.name: CA19-9
10985677.description: Carbohydrate antigen 19-9 , also known as sialyl-LewisA, is a tetrasaccharide which is usually attached to O-glycans on the surface of cells.
synonyms: sialyl Le^A, SLe^A, cancer antigen 19-9, CA19-9

11079373.name: Cyclohexyne
11079373.description: Cyclohexyne is an organic compound with the formula C2 4. It strained cyclic alkyne. Due to its high ring strain, cyclohexyne cannot be isolated but exists only as a short-lived reactive intermediate.

11110989.name: Cyclopentadienyliron dicarbonyl dimer
11110989.description: Cyclopentadienyliron dicarbonyl dimer is an organometallic compound with the formula [ Fe 2]2, often abbreviated to Cp2Fe2 4, [CpFe 2]2 or even Fp2, with the colloquial name "fip dimer".

11961293.name: Felcisetrag
11961293.description: Felcisetrag is a drug which acts as a potent and highly selective agonist for the serotonin receptor 5-HT4. It is in clinical trials for the treatment of gastroparesis.

13316557.name: Fladrafinil
13316557.description: Fladrafinil , also known as fluorafinil or as bisfluoroadrafinil, is a wakefulness-promoting agent related to modafinil that was never marketed.

14619981.name: Iron germanide
14619981.description: Iron germanide is an intermetallic compound, a germanide of iron.

15797581.name: Osmium pentafluoride
15797581.description: Osmium pentafluoride is an inorganic compound with the formula OsF5. It is a blue-green solid. Like the pentafluorides of Ru, Rh, and Ir, OsF5 exists as a tetramer in the solid state.

15978061.name: Herrmann's catalyst
15978061.description: Herrmann's catalyst is an organopalladium compound that is a popular catalyst for the Heck reaction.

16129869.name: Punicalagin
16129869.description: Punicalagin is an ellagitannin, a type of phenolic compound.

16206925.name: DPP-26
16206925.description: DPP-26 is an opioid analgesic drug which has been sold as a designer drug. It is the sulfone analogue of dipipanone in the same way that IC-26 is the sulfone analogue of methadone.

16217677.name: Lanthanum aluminate
16217677.description: Lanthanum aluminate is an inorganic compound with the formula LaAlO3, often abbreviated as LAO. It is an optically transparent ceramic oxide with a distorted perovskite structure.

21884237.name: RU-57073
21884237.description: RU-57073 is a nonsteroidal antiandrogen which was never marketed. It shows 163% of the affinity of testosterone for the androgen receptor and negligible affinity for other steroid hormone receptors.

22049997.name: PH-797804
22049997.description: PH-797804 is a drug which acts as a selective inhibitor of the enzyme p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase .

22081485.name: Triphosphono phosphate
22081485.description: Triphosphono phosphate is the simplest branched polyphosphoric acid. It is a hexaprotic acid. It is used to prepare phosphoric monoesters.

22238669.name: Ammonium hexafluoroplatinate
22238669.description: Ammonium hexafluoroplatinate is an inorganic chemical compound with the chemical formula 2PtF6. It forms pale yellow, cubic crystals.

23653581.name: GTx-027
23653581.description: GTx-027 is a selective androgen receptor modulator which was under development for or of potential interest in the treatment of breast cancer and stress urinary incontinence but was never marketed.

24180941.name: Potassium ferrioxalate
24180941.description: Potassium ferrioxalate, also called potassium trisoxalatoferrate or potassium tris ferrate is a chemical compound with the formula K3[Fe 3].

24826317.name: Histamine glutarimide
24826317.description: Histamine glutarimide is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated for the treatment of cough in acute respiratory infection. It is a glutaminyl cyclase inhibitor.

44254797.name: Farinomalein
44254797.description: Farinomalein is a natural maleimide with formula C10H13NO4 - was first isolated from the entomopathogenic fungus Isaria farinosa - source H599 .

44584013.name: Bisvertinolone
44584013.description: Bisvertinolone is an anticancer metabolite of Trichoderma.

44719565.name: EMM (drug)
44719565.description: EMM, also known as 2-ethoxy-4,5-dimethoxyamphetamine or as TMA2-2-EtO, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families related to the psychedelic drug TMA-2.

53393997.name: AM-2201
53393997.description: AM-2201 (1- -3- indole) is a recreational designer drug that acts as a potent but nonselective full agonist for the cannabinoid receptor.

58604493.name: Castor oil glycidyl ether
58604493.description: Castor oil glycidyl ether is a liquid organic chemical in the glycidyl ether family.

60153165.name: Aplyzanzine A
60153165.description: Aplyzanzine A is a bio-active isolate of marine sponge.

71308237.name: Methade

72202701.description: Vebreltinib is a pharmaceutical drug used for the treatment of cancer.

72823501.name: Galtamycin B
72823501.description: Galtamycin B is a chemical compound that has been isolated from Micromonospora.

73415757.name: Bismuth oxynitrate
73415757.description: Bismuth oxynitrate is the name applied to a number of compounds that contain Bi3+, nitrate ions and oxide ions and which can be considered as compounds formed from Bi2O3, N2O5 and H2O.

76957773.name: Lorajmine
76957773.description: Lorajmine is a drug that is a potent sodium channel blocker (more specifically, a class Ia antiarrhythmic agent) that was used for treating arrhythmia.

85994061.name: Bromofluorodiiodomethane
85994061.description: Bromofluorodiiodomethane is a tetrahalomethane with the chemical formula CBrFI2.

101651021.name: Stenophyllanin A
101651021.description: Stenophyllanin A is an ellagitannin. It can be found in Cowania mexicana, Coleogyne ramosissima and Quercus stenophylla.

118796493.name: 4-Methoxybutyrfentanyl
118796493.description: 4-Methoxybutyrfentanyl is an opioid analgesic that is an analog of butyrfentanyl and has been sold online as a designer drug.

118856397.name: Dodecacalcium hepta-aluminate
118856397.description: Dodecacalcium hepta-aluminate is an inorganic solid that occurs rarely in nature as the mineral mayenite.

118861389.name: Firmonertinib
118861389.description: Firmonertinib (previously referred to as alflutinib and furmonertinib) is targeted drug that that is approved in China for the treatment of non-small cell lung cancer .

124111565.name: Tolebrutinib
124111565.description: Tolebrutinib, sold under the brand name Cenrifki, is a medication used for the treatment of multiple sclerosis.

129514317.name: 25T2-NBOMe
129514317.description: 25T2-NBOMe, also known as N- -4-ethylthio-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a serotonergic psychedelic of the 25-NB family. It is the NBOMe analogue of 2C-T-2.

129629261.name: Promethium(III) nitrate
129629261.description: Promethium nitrate is an inorganic compound, a salt of promethium and nitric acid with the chemical formula Pm 3. The compound is radioactive, soluble in water and forms crystalline hydrates.

135564749.name: Apabetalone
135564749.description: Apabetalone (development codes RVX 208, RVX-208, and RVX000222) is an orally available small molecule created by Resverlogix Corp.

137460941.name: Suntinorexton
137460941.description: Suntinorexton (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name) is an experimental orexin receptor agonist.

139063629.name: Decamethyldizincocene
139063629.description: Decamethyldizincocene is an organozinc compound with the formula [Zn2 2].

140332365.name: Sodium bis(carbonato)cuprate(II)
140332365.description: Sodium bis cuprate is a complex compound of copper containing the carbonato ligand, with the chemical formula Na2[Cu 2]. It forms royal blue, monoclinic crystals. A trihydrate exists.

150357965.name: RDS03-94
150357965.description: RDS03-94, or RDS3-094, is an atypical dopamine reuptake inhibitor that was derived from the wakefulness-promoting agent modafinil.

155321421.name: Zevaquenabant
155321421.description: Zevaquenabant is an investigational small-molecule drug, discovered by Dr George Kunos, Dr Resat Cinar, and Dr Malliga iyer at the National Institutes of Health.

155538637.name: ADB-P7AICA

166468301.name: Lys-MDMA
166468301.description: Lys-MDMA, or lysine-MDMA, also known as N- -MDMA, is an intended prodrug of MDMA which was being investigated for possible use as a pharmaceutical drug in the treatment of psychiatric disorders.

900000717.name: Enfortumab vedotin

900000845.name: Fluticasone furoate/umeclidinium bromide/vilanterol

900001101.name: Lamivudine/nevirapine/zidovudine
900001101.description: Lamivudine/nevirapine/zidovudine is a fixed-dose combination antiretroviral medication used to treat HIV/AIDS.

900001229.name: Malaria vaccine

900001357.description: Nerelimomab is a mouse monoclonal antibody acting as a TNF inhibitor.

900001613.name: Poly-N-(3-sulfopropyl)aniline
900001613.description: Poly is a water-soluble, self-doped conducting polymer belonging to the polyaniline family.

900001997.name: Tenecteplase
900001997.description: Tenecteplase, sold under the brand name Metalyse among others, is an enzyme used as a thrombolytic drug.

900002125.description: VOLT-02 is a water-soluble conjugate of progesterone and a neurosteroid which is under development by Levolta Pharmaceuticals for the treatment of traumatic brain injury, gynecological disorders, and...
